description: The Felsenkirche (Rock Church) at Lüderitz, seen from the Diamantberg above the town
verification_note: Looking down from the rock: the Felsenkirche with its blue-slate spire on the left, the coloured tin roofs of the town filling the middle, and beyond them the port, cranes, tank farm and the Shark Island peninsula, with an anchored ship offshore. The most informative single frame of this port.
